_about: STYLE CLIPS (2026-09-15): owner "add more dynamic moves like 360 hook kicks, capoeira like movements like youre break dancing if you choose that style, advanced taekwando and tricking, parkour". CMU subjects 85/87/88/90 (downloaded with approval), 75/127 (from zips on disk). Windows chosen off scripts/mocap/take-events.mts + take-timeline.mts. Every clip carries a ROOT TRACK (the pelvis turns over). replaces = the base clip name a fight mode requests; style = the vocabulary. · 2026-09-15 review: the 'monkey sequence' kicks (cap_meia_lua / cap_queixada / cap_martelo) and trick_high_kick were dropped — the capture is a crouched ape walk, they read as crawling; the light links borrow the clean karate captures (styleMotion STYLE_BORROWS). · TRUE FPS (hoops motion 2b, 2026-09-25): subjects 75 and 88 are 60-fps captures stamped 120 (sources.mts CMU_TRUE_FPS); their windows here are TRUE seconds (doubled from the header seconds they were chosen in, so the same frames are cut) and their `duration` is a TEMP pin (`pin`) that keeps the played length to the millisecond until the boards / combat motion passes; the other subjects (85, 90, 127) measure 120, and 87 is left at its header (its flips vote both ways; its two clips hold explicit durations, so they play the same either way). `smoothSec` 0.07 on a pinned clip keeps the retarget's smoothing on the same frames, so its keys are unchanged.
